hypothesis: PHASE-2 experiment #3 (RESUME.md phase-2 ranked list): temporal smoothing of P_cam before fusion, isolated from the family-#2 threshold change to measure its standalone effect. New --cam-smooth-bins flag (implemented during iteration 2): max-pool each node's P_cam over a +/-N bin window before fusion, bridging short camera gaps legitimately (the object cannot teleport at 0.5s bin resolution). This run uses +/-2 bins (+/-1.0s) on the standard run-236 camera recipe: camera fusion, soft-scale 0.8, soft-threshold 0.4, run 227 base, 200 iterations, --gps-eval, session 20250812_165739 (camera-only fusion, so --calibrators correctly not required). TRACKER CONFIG: time_limit=1, max_sensors=6 (defaults, unchanged); lock bar stays 0.5 — only P_cam's temporal support widens. Analytic pre-check (diag_phase2_coverage.txt): +/-2-bin smoothing raises cam-only GT-node lock coverage from 73.85% (96/130) to 83.85% (109/130), residual gaps [10, 8, 3] — coincidentally identical coverage to run 608's or_max@0.2, so the baselines should land near each other (~93%) if smoothing engages correctly in the eval path. Width choice justified from the logged coverage curve: +/-1 (80.77%) is strictly dominated by +/-2, and +/-3 (1.5s) exceeds the 0.5-1s non-teleportation legitimacy window, so only +/-2 gets a training run. Exact command saved at experiments/run609/cmd.sh.
findings: Second independent confirmation of the phase-2 coverage diagnosis, via the camera-smoothing route: best accuracy 93.25% at iter 39 (5.23 nodes/step), baseline 91.90% (5.25). The baseline ALONE (un-fine-tuned run-227 policy, only P_cam smoothed +/-2 bins in the reward/lock path) beats the entire phase-1 best (91.00%, run 236), and the fine-tuned peak lands +2.25pp above it. Smoothing raised P_cam mean 0.209 -> 0.261 and positive rate 0.263 -> 0.328 (max unchanged, 0.970). Result sits just below run 608's 93.70% despite identical analytic lock coverage (83.85% both) — consistent with WHICH steps get covered differing: smoothing only bridges the six short gaps (~7 steps adjacent to live camera), while 608's audio rescue recovers 13 steps scattered inside the long gaps; both routes converging to ~93-94% reinforces that accuracy is now coverage-bound, not policy-bound. Fine-tuning again adds little (+1.35pp) and the peak-then-decay shape persists (iters 196-200 oscillate 82.8-90.1%), so early stopping at the saved best checkpoint remains essential. Next: run 610 combines both routes (or_max@0.2 + calibrators + cam-smooth 2, analytic coverage 90.00%) — if the coverage->accuracy mapping holds (83.85% coverage -> 93.3-93.7%), 90% coverage projects to ~95-97%, the first credible shot at the 95.00% target.
